nodes.text: Christ and Judas were playing at spears. Then the holy Christ was wounded
in his side. Then he took his thumb and pressed it shut at the front. So
stand still, blood, as the river Jordan stood still when the holy John
baptised the Saviour Christ in it. May that be your cure.
that became known there in heaven.
It did not bleed, nor did it ache,
nor did it bring forth any pus.
That was a very good hour.
In the name of Jesus Christ, may that be your cure. The Our Father three times, and
adding this, likewise three times: I conjure you by the holy five
wounds, be healed, you wound! And by the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit,
let it be, let it be, amen.
